warnings: Anomaly severity is not a failure probability.
First 30 training cycles are assumed to represent healthy operation.
Simulated asset start times are not observed fleet chronology.
Five grouped folds do not establish novelty or deployment readiness.
thresholds: validation threshold assets only; held-out metrics are retrospective
threshold_grid: 19 fixed caution points from 0.05 to 0.95; 60 validation-score quantiles from 0.05 to 0.995; plus 1.000001 no-alert sentinel; critical threshold midpoint(caution,1.0)
outcome_role: retrospective analysis and delayed feedback scheduler
